cells.tense: You are here, with the pen down, and what you imagined has been felt.
cells.ask: Invite someone you like into the making of one thing you are currently only making alone, and let them change it.
cells.core:
You can sit inside someone else's experience without losing your own. That is rare and you do it easily. Someone tells you a thing and you feel the shape of it, and you also stay yourself, so they come away understood rather than fixed.

And the imagining is flowing from that. You are not dreaming ahead of what you have actually lived; you are dreaming out of it. What you make has been through feeling, and it keeps its shape when you hand it over. This is the steady version, quieter than the high of a new idea. Feed it something next: let one person into a thing you were going to finish alone.
cells.sheetLine: You dream from what you have already felt, and it holds.
cells.verb: feeling what was imagined all the way to the end
cells.place: standing close enough to feel what someone else feels

cells.tense: You will have felt it all by the time anyone else gets there.
cells.ask: Pick one person you are trying to hold steady right now and tell them only what you actually know, not what you have rehearsed about what they might need next.
cells.core:
You are feeling ahead of the curve. Before the conversation happens, you have already imagined how it will go, felt what they will feel, worked out the shape of the whole thing in advance. It is remarkable, and it is spending the very tenderness it came from.

Because the imagining has outrun the actual experience. You are holding space for feelings that have not landed yet, tending something that is still only a sketch. Nobody asked you to carry it forward that far. The timing is off, not the caring. One person, one honest sentence, right now — that is the way back.
cells.sheetLine: You are feeling it before it happens, and it is wearing you out.

cells.tense: You stopped imagining that any of it was worth the trouble.
cells.ask: Name one thing you have information about in a situation you have been pretending is undecided, then keep that read to yourself for a day instead of talking over it.
cells.core:
Somewhere the imagining stopped. You are not dreaming ahead anymore; you are managing what is already in front of you. So the feeling-with has nothing to run on. You can still hear what someone is going through, but it lands flat, and you end up agreeing with whatever version of it is easiest to carry.

What is missing is not the ability to connect. It is that your own read has gone quiet, so there is nothing solid in you to feel anyone else's experience against. There is more in your hands than you have been letting yourself say. Hold one piece of it quietly for a day, and the room comes back into the body.
cells.sheetLine: Not numb — you just stopped trusting your own read.

cells.tense: You are already doing it, and telling yourself it was nothing you chose.
cells.ask: Say out loud, to one person, 'I chose to spend time on that,' about something you have been calling just what the week needed.
cells.core:
You are already making people feel met — in what you say back, what you let go by, when you stay. It is working. But when you describe it, the shape is gone: the week was busy, they were going through it, that is just what needed doing. The hand making the connection is not the one you are pointing at.

Nothing is wrong with the doing. What is missing is the saying. There is one choice you made this week that you have been calling a circumstance, and naming it out loud to one person would not be bragging. It would just be the hand back on the pen.
cells.sheetLine: You are already choosing the connection. Admit one choice.

A reader could say the person is simply worn down by a situation, not saturated by their own feeling. The ask survives being wrong because it only asks the person to finish one thing already in motion, which is useful whether the block is saturation or fatigue. The sentence that serves me more than them is 'satisfied not because everything is perfect but because what was imagined has been felt' — it dresses the card in its own vocabulary and is not the person's.
